Define the E05 admission predicate and walkthrough table before searching. A genuine conflict requires incompatible claims about the same entity, perimeter, concept, dimensions, units, basis and economic period; faithful extraction from distinct source assertions; consideration of precision; and no supported correction/supersession relation explaining the difference. Duplicate representations do not supply independent assertions. Record unknown context or availability explicitly.

Save each inspected group immediately into a new versioned document under docs/design/proposal/architecture/. Record candidate IDs, source paths/hashes, exact quotations/locators, context comparison, supported chronology, extraction-review status and disposition. Distinguish genuine conflict, correction/supersession, compatible exposure, unresolved context and synthetic example. Apple fixed-rate notes plus swaps and P07's 720-to-120-to-110 chain cannot establish genuine conflict merely because their numbers or descriptions differ.
